name: Runner Extras - SingleInstance codeunit outlives its creating scope
brief: Pins the SingleInstance codeunit contract: one instance per test, state kept across scope exits, per-call codeunits not shared.
description: A SingleInstance codeunit lives for the whole test and routinely outlives the AL scope that first resolved it. The runner cached it in a plain C# dictionary while leaving it parented on that scope, so when the scope subtree was disposed the instance went with it and every global record handle on it read back null (NavApplicationObjectBaseHandle.Target returns null for a disposed tree rather than rebuilding), NREing inside BC with no message. These tests pin the contract that fix must preserve — including a per-call control proving the fix does not fuse unrelated callers by rooting every codeunit on the session. They do NOT reproduce the disposal itself: see the header comment in SisTests.Codeunit.al for what was tried and why the real reproduction is the Pageworks suite.
